description: This file defines the main React component for the home page of a web application, including theme switching, language setting, dynamic imports of subcomponents, routing, and data loading logic.

methods.name: Loading
methods.description: React component displaying a loading indicator, optionally without a logo.

methods.description: Custom hook to set the HTML document language based on locale.

methods.name: useHasHydrated
methods.description: Hook to determine if the React app has hydrated.

methods.name: loadAsyncGoogleFont
methods.description: Function to asynchronously load Google Fonts.

methods.name: Screen
methods.description: Main component managing routing and layout of the app.
